assessed_concepts: Original source task: Describe how the derived field Age would be calculated.
Describe how to calculate a person’s completed years of age from birth year/month/day and today’s year/month/day, assuming a valid ordinary date

markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [2 max] Award [1] for identifying the data from the database; Award [1] for the correct formula to create the derived data; [DateOfBirth] = SELECT DateOfBirth FROM Table Age = YEAR ([Date]) – YEAR([DateOfBirth]) SELECT DATEDIFF (YYYY, DateOfBirth, GetDate()) AS Age FROM Table SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, DateOfBirth, CURDATE()) AS Age FROM Table; SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') - DATE_FORMAT(DOB, '%Y') AS age FROM Table Accept similar structure Accept answers in structured English example: Select Date of Birth from the patient table; Subtract the year of the birth date from the current year to get the “Age”;
source_issues: Some source MS formulas subtract years only and overstate age before the birthday. Adaptation explicitly calculates completed years.
